name: services/facperms/effective_fac_ids
description:
Get a complete list of all faculty IDs in which the given user has a given effective role/permission.

In cases when the user has been granted the role with the with_subfaculties flag set, the list will include all those subfaculties. (You cannot achieve this effect with the select method.)
brief_description: Get a list of faculty IDs in which the user has a role.

arguments.name: fpclass_id
arguments.description: ID of the faculty permission class.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Unordered list of strings - IDs of the faculties.
